starters.text: Under the box on a new task, four at most: the project’s own ideas, then those for everywhere, then what you often ask there. A click puts its request in the box, to change before it goes.
starters.theirs: Your organization’s ideas show while you have none of your own.
starters.everywhere.text: In every project, after the project’s own.
starters.first: In this project, before those for everywhere.
starters.noticed.text: Requests made three times or more in the project you’re in, and its flows, shown after your own.
